name: Wimpering Wand
description: Once per day, the user may activate the wand by reciting, “Whimpering Wand, Whimpering Wand, tell me if frightful things lie beyond.” For the next hour, the wand is aware of any threatening creatures within far range and will whimper in accordance with the severity of the threat and/or the number of the foes: A single, minor foe at the edge of the range will cause it to emit a barely audible whimper, while many fearsome foes close at hand will cause it to emit frightened shouts. The wand may be commanded to silence at any time by the same person who activated it.
